pause.name: Pause schedule
pause.description: Pause all shutter plans. Ventilation and lockout protection keep working. Without duration or end, the pause lasts until resumed.

resume.name: Resume schedule
resume.description: End the pause. Shutters move again at the next plan change.

start_vacation.name: Start vacation
start_vacation.description: All rooms with a plan follow the vacation plan until the end.

random.name: Random delay
random.description: Each move happens up to this many minutes later, so the house does not look empty.

end_vacation.name: End vacation
end_vacation.description: Rooms follow their own plans again.

apply_plan.name: Apply plan now
apply_plan.description: Move a room's shutters to where its plan has them right now.
